stage_info.name: particle_picking
stage_info.description: Particle picking stage: Detect and extract particles from micrographs using blob picker

input.micrograph_location_description: Location of the micrographs for particle picking. If null, will read from the output of the preprocessing agent. Can be a CryoSPARC job UID (e.g., 'J84') or a path to micrographs.

blob_picker.particle_diameter_description: Minimum expected particle diameter in Angstroms. This is the most critical parameter for blob detection and should match the actual size of your protein complex. Typical range: 50-500 Å.
blob_picker.diameter_max_description: Maximum particle diameter in Angstroms. If null, defaults to 2.0 × particle_diameter. Defines the upper bound of the particle size search range. Useful for particles with size variation.

particle_extraction.box_size_pix_description: Extraction box size in pixels. Should be at least 1.5-2× the particle diameter in pixels. Common values: 128, 256, 320, 384, 512. Larger boxes capture more context but require more memory.
particle_extraction.extract_downscale_factor_description: Downsampling factor for extraction. 1.0 = no downsampling. Values like 2.0 or 4.0 reduce box size for initial processing and speed. Typical range: 1.0-4.0.
particle_extraction.bg_radius_description: Background normalization radius in Angstroms. If null, defaults to particle_diameter/2. Used to normalize particle images by subtracting local background.
particle_extraction.invert_contrast_description: Whether to invert image contrast. Set to true if particles appear dark on light background (most common). Set to false if particles appear bright.

2d_classification.num_classes_description: Number of 2D classes to generate. More classes provide finer particle views but require more particles. Typical range: 20-200 depending on dataset size and particle heterogeneity.
2d_classification.max_iterations_description: Maximum number of classification iterations. More iterations allow better convergence but take longer. Typical range: 15-30.
2d_classification.initial_resolution_description: Initial resolution limit in Angstroms for classification. Start with lower resolution (higher value) for better initial alignment. Typical range: 10-20 Å.
2d_classification.final_resolution_description: Final resolution limit in Angstroms. The algorithm progressively increases resolution up to this limit. Should match expected resolution of 2D classes. Typical range: 4-8 Å.
2d_classification.batch_size_per_class_description: Number of particles per class for online-EM updates. Larger values are more stable but slower. Typical range: 100-500.
2d_classification.force_max_res_description: Whether to force maximum resolution limit throughout classification. If false, resolution increases adaptively during iterations.

steps.name: blob_picker
steps.description: Detect particles using GPU-accelerated Gaussian blob detection algorithm. The blob picker identifies circular features (blobs) in micrographs within a specified diameter range.
steps.notes: Requires completed micrograph selection or CTF estimation job as input. Uses 'blob_picker_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. The micrographs_job_uid should point to a curate_exposures_v2 job with 'exposures_accepted' output containing curated micrographs.

steps.name: particle_extraction
steps.description: Extract particle images from micrographs using coordinates from blob picker. Creates particle stacks with specified box size and optional downsampling.
steps.notes: Uses 'extract_micrographs_gpu' job type in CryoSPARC. The particle_locations_job_uid comes from blob_picker output. Box size should accommodate particle diameter with sufficient padding.

steps.name: 2d_classification
steps.description: Classify extracted particles into 2D class averages using online-EM algorithm. Helps assess particle quality and identify good particles for 3D reconstruction.
steps.notes: Uses 'class_2D' job type in CryoSPARC. The particles_job_uid comes from extraction output. Good 2D classes indicate proper particle picking and extraction. Poor classes suggest issues with picking parameters or sample quality.
